verdict.rationale: Graphite lists AI generation of PR titles and descriptions as a feature, and Graphite Chat can summarize or explain a PR's changes on demand. The only thing it runs automatically on every PR is AI review, which looks for bugs rather than writing a summary or walkthrough. So the summary is either author-triggered or reviewer-requested, not an automatic per-PR orientation artifact. Missing for 10: evidence that summaries are generated automatically on every PR, a structured file-by-file change walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
